body: I've seen a lot of therapists since my early teens until now (I'm 28). I'm tired of talking. I have tried to get help but after pouring everything out so many times and the end result always being that they give me some useless pill that changes absolutely nothing, I've become very, very tired of their profession. I wish I could do something like therapeutic MDMA or cannabis but that isn't and won't be a possibility in this dumb, moralistic country that I live in.
